title: Deck Outline (radiation.deck_outline/1) — S-2-PPTX-A stage 1
description: Outline is the receipt; deck is its rendering. A deck is a Nota answer format, not a product. No .pptx-alone delivery — the outline always ships with the deck. Schema radiation.deck_outline/1. Required: schema_name const, id OUTLINE-<slug>, title, theme {name from theme registry, theme_lock fixed hex set per theme — doctrine locked palettes content decides count}, slides[] {ref, type enum title|section|content|compare|claim-list|closing, bullets[] {text, source_ref string|null}, notes string|null}, constraints[] (rule IDs this outline declares compliance to), provenance {task, date, source_refs[]}, honesty_note optional. Discipline: source_ref admissible only to register lanes (SRC-, ANNOT_, TRI_, CARD_, GAP-, R2-... — data, nothing else); outline bullet without source_ref is claim awaiting one and lint may warn (never fail) on it as UNBACKED-BULLET. Theme registry v0: anchor + slate PROVISIONAL until Commander's theme notes, 5 fixed hexes each. Budgets computed at outline time so box never decides silently later (F1/F2 lesson: 4,000-char bullet saves silently).
